chunks: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Masroor (may God be pleased with him) narrated that be pleased with him) narrated that Al-Hussein ibn Muhammad ibn Amer, from his uncle Abdullah ibn Amer, from Muhammad ibn Zyad, from Sayf ibn Umayrih, who said: The Sadiq, Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them) said:

Whoever does not care about what he says or what is said about him is a partner of Satan, and whoever does not care that people see him doing evil is a partner of Satan, and whoever backbites his believing brother without a pause between them is a partner of Satan, and whoever delights in the love of the forbidden and the lust of adultery is a partner of Satan,

Then he (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, the children of adultery have signs: one is hatred of us, the Ahl al-Bayt; second is that he yearns for the forbidden thing from which he was created; third is contempt for the religion; fourth is ill-repute among people, and he does not have a good reputation among his brothers except he who was born on a bed other than his father's, or [he] whose mother carried him during her menstruation.
ai.seo_question: What are the four signs of the children of adultery according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq linking these four spiritual and social markers—hatred of the Ahl al-Bayt, yearning for the forbidden, contempt for religion, and poor social standing—to the metaphysical reality of conception outside lawful marriage. This tradition underscores the Shia belief that the lineage of the impure manifests in distinct psychological and communal traits, serving as a diagnostic tool for understanding spiritual deviation.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 4-40 Ja’far ibn Muhammad ibn Masroor - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Al-Hussein ibn Muhammad ibn Amer quoted his uncle Abdullah ibn Amer, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Zyad, on the authority of Sayf ibn Umayrih, on the authority of Ja’far ibn Muhammad as-Sadiq (MGB), “

Whoever doesn’t care about what he says or what he is toldis a sort of partner for Satan. Whoever doesn’t care about what evil deeds he does in front of the people is a sort of partner for Satan. Whoever gossips about a believer unduly is a sort of partner for Satan. Whoever enjoys forbidden love and the lust of adultery is a sort of partner for Satan.

The Imam (MGB) then added, “Bastards have definite characteristics: First, they hate us - members of the Household of the Holy Prophet (MGB). Second, they long for the illegitimate way in which they themselves were created. Third, they disparage the religion. Fourth, they mistreat the people. They are only welcomed by those who were conceived through their mother having sex with men other than her husband, or whose mothers conceived them in their periods of menstruation.”
